summary: eRepublik entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: eRepublik

primary.why: eRepublik is a browser-based massively multiplayer social/political strategy game, so the archive object is the current service, account, country, date, and world-state snapshot rather than a static executable.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official website in a current browser. Record date, browser, account/citizen, country, political party, economic/military state, premium/gold use, and any mobile-app use.

all_releases.reason: secondary: useful for access-state comparison, but browser remains primary.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service state and player account define completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive by date, account/country/world state, and browser/client route.
